description: Sets up Cosend’s “Review request” automation on one WhatsApp number: Tag a customer when the job is done, and a few hours later they get your request for a review. Its settings are this recipe’s own, as its set-up form in Cosend asks them; a setting left out takes its default. It is set up switched off, and acts only once it is switched on. The same recipe is set up once on each number, or once per source when it asks for one. The preview refuses a second one as the save would, and gives no token. Each call needs confirming: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview with the settings as Cosend filled them in and its check of them, and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. Returns the automation, switched off.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

connection_id.description: The WhatsApp number (connection id) this automation belongs to: its triggers come from it, its messages go from it, and its templates are read on it. Required, and it cannot be moved afterwards. The same recipe (slug) can be set up once on each number, or once per source on it when the recipe has `multiple`.

name.description: Its name in Cosend. Left out, it takes the recipe’s name.

settings.description: The recipe’s settings, as its set-up form asks them. A setting left out takes its default; a setting with no default is needed.

delay_hours.description: How long after the tag the request goes out.
delay_hours.title: Hours to wait

fallback_language.description: Sent when the customer’s own language isn’t one of the message’s approved languages. Left empty, the message’s first approved language.
fallback_language.title: Fallback language

not_again_days.description: A customer asked for a review in the last this many days is not asked again. The tag still comes off.
not_again_days.title: Not again within (days)

tag.description: Tag a customer with this when the job is done. The tag comes off once the request has gone.
tag.title: When a contact is tagged

template.description: A message approved by WhatsApp with your review link in it, as a button or in its text. Nothing is filled in.

owner_adds.description: The page where customers review you, like your Google review link. It starts with https://
owner_adds.title: Your review link

components.text: Thank you for choosing us for your recent job. We hope you are happy with the result. Would you take a minute to leave us a review?

template.title: Review request message

name: set_up_review_request
title: Set up “Review request”
